KILLJOY is no longer in active development. Thank you all for your support.

❗ [ WARNING: This game contains blood and gore.] ❗

KILLJOY: INFECTION is a fast-paced zombie survival game where teamwork is key.

The year is 2022.
A deadly virus, known as the Olympus Virus, has escaped containment after a BDC bio-lab was breached. 

Originating from Martian fungus samples, it has spread rapidly across the East Coast of the Robloxian States, turning the infected into grotesque, mindless killers.

Society is on the brink of collapse—survival is the only option.

👥 Play with friends for the best experience.

games.name: SCP: Facility Breach
games.desc:
SCP: Facility Breach is a casual round-based horror game that features many roles and factions to play as, with many possessing unique abilities! Massacre everyone as an anomalous entity, raid the facility as an invading insurgency, protect the Foundation as a Task Force soldier, lay waste to the EVERYTHING as Valravn, or simply evade and escape. It's up to you.

CONTROLS
Drop Item - (Keyboard: Q) (Controller: Down)
Sprint - (Keyboard: Left Shift) (Controller: Left Trigger)
Interact - (Keyboard: E) (Controller: X)
